identity.description: Zoho CRM is the customer relationship management product from Zoho Corporation, with developer docs under zoho.com/crm/developer.
identity.identity_notes: Official Zoho CRM developer docs at zoho.com/crm/developer match the assigned hint (zoho.com/crm). Regional data centers (e.g., zoho.eu) exist; accounts domain varies by data center.

auth.oauth_flows: Self Client grant (community post: create Self Client in Zoho Developer Console, generate grant code, exchange at accounts-domain /oauth/v2/token, refresh with grant_type=refresh_token). Unverified against official OAuth page content.
auth.token_refresh: Access token valid for one hour; refresh token has unlimited lifetime until revoked by end-user (official OAuth overview).
auth.scopes_notes: Scopes not established from fetched pages.

access.production_restrictions: No app review was found in fetched sources; not verified. API credit limits apply by edition (Free: 5000 credits/24h).

resources: CRM module records (standard and custom modules)
Metadata: modules, fields, layouts, custom views, related lists
read_ops: Fetch metadata of modules, fields, layouts, custom views, related lists
Run SELECT query over CRM data
Retrieve data in bulk via asynchronous APIs
write_ops: Create, update, delete CRM module entities (CRUD)
Push data to Zoho CRM in bulk via asynchronous APIs
api.rate_limits: Free edition: 5000 API credits per rolling 24h window, 1 credit per call; concurrency limit 5 (Free), 10 (Standard), 15 (Professional), 20 (Enterprise), 25 (Ultimate). No time-based per-minute limits stated.
api.limitations: Daily credit limits by edition; MCP calls consume API credits; concurrency limits per org per app. Breadth judged Broad from core CRUD, metadata, query, bulk, notifications; per-module coverage not exhaustively verified.

open_questions: Exact count of official MCP servers: Zoho dev docs say four; a Zoho help-center post says five. Unresolved.
Whether MCP servers require a specific Zoho CRM edition: MCP page names no plan requirement, though sign-up links include plan=enterprise. Unresolved.
Whether a free-edition account can get OAuth Self Client credentials without admin approval: community post suggests yes; not confirmed on official OAuth page.

Official SDK page (zoho.com/crm/developer/docs/api/v8/zoho-crm-sdks.html) content and GitHub repo ownership not verified by fetch; GitHub repo names came from a third-party directory (apideck-style listing), not Zoho.

Community MCP servers: no community GitHub repo for Zoho CRM was confirmed. Third-party commercial connectors exist (Workato prebuilt MCP, CData Zoho CRM MCP, Claude marketplace connector) but are not community repos and were not fetched.
Trial availability and sandbox: not established.
Fetch budget reached before verifying the free edition API-access claim on the official release notes page and the SDK page.
